messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — before we hand over eu-west-gpu-03 to platform, we need a quick security gate check focused on IAM, secrets, and KMS/HSM integration. Can we run the validation checklist today?

ashwin: I can own IAM + KMS smoke tests. Plan: create a temp SA, attach minimal roles, run encrypt/decrypt, then revoke. Will post results.

jordan: I'll do policy review + audit export checks. Need the exact IAM JSON and the KMS key alias. Also want flow logs and CloudTrail/Syslog hookup verified.

sophia: I'll validate Vault mounts and rotation. Reminder: this cluster uses external Vault over VPC peering (no public endpoints). Need to confirm mTLS and cert expiry > 30 days.

maya: Checklist items I'm thinking:
- IAM: least privilege roles for node/agent/controller + IRSA for pods
- Service accounts: one per runtime (infer, autoscaler, operator)
- Secrets: Vault consumption via CSI driver; test read-only mounts + rotation behavior
- KMS: encrypt/decrypt roundtrip, key policy allows platform SA only, CMK alias: alias/redwood/eu-west-gpu-03
- HSM (onprem customers only): attestation + key import logs
- Logging: CloudTrail/Stackdriver export to audit-bucket + SIEM ingestion
- Network: restrict egress, no open 0.0.0.0/0 for control plane; egress fw rules for registries only
- Cost guardrails: confirm billing alerts for HSM hourly & reserved instance SKUs

ashwin: First quick result: created temp SA `infra-temp-kms-checker`, attached `kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt` on alias/redwood/eu-west-gpu-03 and ran:
```
aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/redwood/eu-west-gpu-03 --plaintext "test" | jq -r '.CiphertextBlob' > ct
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct --output text
```
Encrypt/decrypt succeeded. I'll remove the bindings in 10m and post policy.

deploy-bot: infra-ci started: `terraform plan` for eu-west-gpu-03 (run id: p-3492). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/3492

jordan: IAM policy nits: remove `iam:PassRole` from infer service account unless absolutely needed. Add condition on `aws:SourceIp` for control plane actions. Also ensure key policy for CMK explicitly lists the audit account.

sophia: Vault results: CSI mount works, rotation test passed — new version became available within 45s and pods observed secret refresh. However the Vault TLS cert chain had a SHA1-signed intermediate on one side; opened ticket to ops to rotate certs.

maya: Good find. Jordan — can you sign-off assuming ashwin removes PassRole and we get cert rotation ticket?

jordan: Will re-check after PassRole removal. Also need CloudTrail export verified: infra-ci, can you confirm audit-bucket lifecycle + ACLs?

infra-ci: CloudTrail export configured to s3://redwood-audit-eu-west, lifecycle 365d, bucket enforced with block-public-acls. Delivery status: last 24h success.

ashwin: PassRole removed from infer SA and replaced with a dedicated role-per-task pattern. Updated policy: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/redwood/infer-service-minimal`. Pushed to branch.

sophia: Cert rotation ticket created: OPS-1129, ETA 48h. No immediate exploitation risk but we should avoid handoff until rotated.

maya: Ok — blockers: cert rotation. If OPS can rotate within 48h, we can proceed with conditional handoff. Action items:
- ops: rotate Vault certs and confirm (OPS-1129) — assignee @sophia
- ashwin: remove temp SA and attach final policy PR (done) — assignee @ashwin
- jordan: final policy sign-off after cert rotation — assignee @jordan
- infra-ci: ensure CloudTrail -> SIEM ingestion test (3 events) — assignee @infra-ci

jordan: Also flag for on-prem HSM customers: include cost estimate in handoff doc. HSM hourly + ingress egress for key import can add ~20% to baseline.

maya: Noted. I'll update the runbook doc with the cert ticket link and cost note. Link: https://docs.internal/runbooks/secure-cluster-provisioning#eu-west-gpu-03

deploy-bot: `terraform apply` waiting on PR merge: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/1123

maya: Thanks all — once OPS closes OPS-1129 and infra-ci confirms SIEM ingestion, I'll schedule the formal handoff and add Jordan as final approver. If anyone needs to run additional tests ping here. :thumbsup:

ashwin: I'll delete `infra-temp-kms-checker` now and post confirmation.

ashwin: deleted temp SA and confirmed no active keys attached.

jordan: Marking pending -> ready-for-handoff when OPS-1129 closed.

maya: Closing notes for the thread: small checklist added to runbook, cost note added, PR link referenced, OPS ticket linked. Hand-off pending cert rotation. Thanks. :raised_hands:
